open_points.subject: R0-89 migration recovery material versus the one-home rule
open_points.text: “the owner keeps the export file and the picks, names and aliases given in the import until a checked backup holds the import” conflicts with R0-80’s “Other services keep no customer record and no copy of these values” and its exhaustive stated exceptions
open_points.question: Is this retained export and import record an explicit temporary exception to the one-home rule, and must it be listed in the governance until removed?
options: Make the recovery material a temporary governed exception
Require recovery material containing no copied personal values
Do not retain the export after import
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as a temporary governed exception until the qualifying backup is checked.

open_points.subject: R0-89 retained migration recovery material
open_points.text: “the owner keeps the export file and the picks, names and aliases given in the import until a checked backup holds the import”
open_points.question: Where are the export, project picks, replacement names and aliases kept, who can access them, how are they protected, and what observable disposal action occurs when a checked backup holds the import?
options: An encrypted owner-controlled migration bundle outside Registry
A protected record on the production host
open_points.default_guess: Keep one encrypted owner-controlled migration bundle and securely remove it after the qualifying backup check.

open_points.subject: R0-89 retention-review recovery record
open_points.text: “What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship — follows the owner's own record of the retention review”
open_points.question: What system or document is the owner's record, what facts and identifiers must it retain so actions can be repeated, who maintains it, and which trust and retention rules apply to it?
options: The Registry audit log copied outside the restored store
open_points.default_guess: Use a separately protected governance register outside Registry containing the action, target identity, date and outcome.

open_points.subject: R0-89 actions replayed after restoration
open_points.text: “What the owner repeats after a restore — erasures, restrictions, ends of a relationship — follows the owner's own record of the retention review”
open_points.question: Is that list exhaustive, or must the owner also replay inverse or related retention actions lost after the backup, such as lifting restrictions, resuming relationships, project anonymisations and audit-entry erasures?
options: Replay only the three named action categories
Replay every retention-review action recorded after the backup
Define an explicit per-action replay list
open_points.default_guess: Replay every retention-review action recorded after the restored backup, using an explicit per-action list.
